body:
AMEND, not block. The declared Baseball question is narrow enough for a first end-to-end result, and the no-hand-authored-graph, deterministic-resolution, local-only, aggregate-only, null-must-publish boundaries are right. The dependency boundary is not yet sufficient for P1 closure.

Separate START dependencies from CLOSURE gates.

START requires four exact landed facts: (1) the owner-recorded human-recall-corpus/REB disposition in Q5 bd-01M184XP908JX51S3ZYFX20HC7; the chief letter itself calls the real corpus owner-blocked. (2) The landed NFRD intake and frozen 57/28/28 participant partition, not merely its current pending candidate. Its own design says UntouchedTest is untouched only within a Diagnostic protocol and does not make one story calibrated or generalizable. (3) A real proposition-provider implementation with coverage and abstention receipts; cand-70K5PT8QSX3JPC8X0X7ZHEAWX1 is explicitly the no-model contract slice and cannot satisfy this edge. (4) The landed transition-missingness repair; its reviewed/authorized candidate is still behind an ancestor ghost.

P1 CLOSURE additionally requires three explicit gates that should not be hidden inside the integration bead: (5) a predeclared external/refusal calibration court using Development and Calibration only, with loss, refusal rule, uncertainty, and no tuning on the 28 UntouchedTest participants; the WOG 1.4806 result is a diagnostic, not a floor target. (6) The eligible-term carrier from bd-01M166XWESBS1JZ5B38H0ZZ2DK before support is interpreted, so a zero-eligible external cell cannot advertise full support beside a measured anchor. (7) Unforgeable result receipts from bd-01M183VBPNEAPT5JNQMBMYMKQ9 before the answer is accepted as auditable; running the court may precede this, closing P1 may not.

The estimand also needs one sentence sharper than consistently. Freeze the unit and denominator as participant by eligible source situation; make recalled versus omitted a declared complement only where eligibility is known; treat compression, blending, and revisiting as typed relation/trajectory events that may overlap rather than one forced category; name the population statistic and interval for each. Label the result Baseball Diagnostic and prohibit generalization beyond this story/cohort.

With those amendments I support creation of one integration parent whose explicit dependency edges reflect the start/closure split. Parent relations or prose references are not blockers. WHAT I DID NOT DO: I did not inspect participant bytes, rerun NFRD, or validate provider quality; this disposition derives from the live bead/candidate contracts and the committed diagnostic-court specification.
